Generate the autocompletion script for agent for the specified shell.
See each sub-command's help for details on how to use the generated script.

Usage:
  agent completion [command]

Available Commands:
  bash        Generate the autocompletion script for bash
  zsh         Generate the autocompletion script for zsh
  fish        Generate the autocompletion script for fish
  powershell  Generate the autocompletion script for powershell

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for completion

Global Flags:
      --backend string          Backend for spawn or adopt: claude, aider, agy, or shell (spawn requires it or --backend-config; adopt auto-detects)
      --backend-config string   JSON file defining a custom backend (or app settings); pass it again to status/wait/watch for agents spawned with it
  -q, --quiet                   Don't print hints (results and errors still print)
      --termd-ns string         g3d-termd namespace (default: agents; never default or wall)

Use "agent completion [command] --help" for more information about a command.
